Featured guide · 8 minute read

How Often Should You Valet a Car?

A well-kept daily car normally benefits from frequent maintenance cleaning and a more complete valet every few months. High-use, family, pet or passenger vehicles need attention sooner, while spills, damp and organic contamination should be treated promptly rather than left until the next planned visit.

There is no single valeting interval that suits every vehicle. The right frequency depends on mileage, passengers, pets, parking conditions, the season and the presentation standard you want to maintain.

Washing & decontamination

3 guides
8 minute read

Hand Wash vs Automatic Car Wash

Both methods remove visible dirt, but the contact process, attention to detailed areas and control over products can be very different. The right choice depends on the finish you want and the condition of the vehicle.

Read guide
8 minute read

Decontamination Wash vs Clay Bar

A normal wash removes loose dirt but not every bonded deposit. Chemical decontamination and clay treatment go further, although they are not interchangeable and should be selected from paint condition.

Read guide
8 minute read

Car Cleaning Before Vehicle Graphics or Wrapping

Vinyl needs a clean, stable surface. Wax, traffic film, tar and bonded contamination can interfere with preparation and should be addressed before graphics or wrapping begins.

Read guide

Stage 1 vs Multi-Stage Polishing

The correct polishing process depends on paint condition, defect depth, previous repairs, available clear coat and the finish you want to achieve. More correction is not automatically the safest choice.

9 minute read

Ceramic Coating Aftercare

Ceramic coating makes routine maintenance easier, but it does not remove the need for safe washing and does not protect paint from every type of damage.

9 minute read

Ceramic Coating vs Car Wax

Wax and ceramic coating can both improve finish and water behaviour, but they differ considerably in preparation, durability, maintenance and cost.

What Does Machine Polishing Remove?

Machine polishing can transform gloss and clarity, but the safest result depends on defect depth, paint condition and how much material can responsibly be removed.

Ceramic Protection for Vehicle Graphics and Wraps

A compatible coating can make graphics and wraps easier to maintain, but the product and preparation must suit the vinyl finish, age and manufacturer guidance.
